title: Tightened fallback handling across routing, lanes, and answers
points: Serve operations now require a deterministic fallback inventory and risk rating before changing fallback behavior, so eval fixes do not bypass the router, lane, and analyst stage contracts.
Analyst answer handling now relies on prompts and retrieved evidence for P/E, FCFE, ROIC, and model-only behavior instead of post-generation answer rewrites.
Lanes that fail to make a valid submit no longer feed unsubmitted probe rows or auto-selected pages into the final analyst context.
